note: New meals built around this week's Woolworths specials.

meals.tip: Fresh ravioli is half price this week
steps: Roast diced pumpkin 20 min.
Layer ravioli, sauce, pumpkin and spinach; top with cheese.
Bake 20 min until bubbling.

ingredients: 625 g fresh filled ravioli or tortellini
500 g pumpkin, peeled and cut into 2 cm cubes
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the pumpkin with the oil and a pinch of salt on a lined tray and roast for 20 minutes until soft.
Meanwhile stir the garlic and oregano through the pasta sauce.
Spread a third of the sauce over the base of a large baking dish.
Add the uncooked ravioli in one layer, then scatter over the roasted pumpkin and the spinach.
Pour over the rest of the sauce, making sure the pasta is covered, and sprinkle with the mozzarella.
Bake for 20 minutes until the sauce is bubbling and the cheese is golden. Rest 5 minutes before serving.
recipe.kids: Scoop kids a portion from the edge where there's less spinach, with extra cheese on top.

meals.n: Honey-garlic pork steaks with pumpkin mash
steps: Slice the pork loin into 2 cm steaks.
Pan-fry and glaze with honey, soy and garlic.
Serve with pumpkin mash and beans.

ingredients: 800 g pork loin (from the roast), sliced into 2 cm steaks
steps: Boil the pumpkin and potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until very soft. Drain and mash with the butter and a pinch of salt.
Mix the honey, soy sauce and garlic in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Season the pork steaks and cook 3–4 minutes each side until golden and just cooked through.
Turn the heat to low, pour in the honey-soy mix and turn the steaks to coat for 1 minute until sticky. Rest 3 minutes.
Steam or microwave the beans for 3 minutes.
Serve the pork on the mash with the beans, spooning over the pan glaze.
recipe.kids: Slice the pork thinly for kids and keep the glaze light.

meals.n: Lamb chop tray bake with potatoes & pumpkin
steps: Roast potatoes and pumpkin 20 min.
Add the chops and roast 20 min more.
Serve with beans and gravy.

ingredients: 600 g potatoes, cut into 3 cm chunks
500 g pumpkin, cut into 3 cm chunks
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the potatoes and pumpkin with 1 tbsp oil, salt and half the rosemary on a large tray. Roast 20 minutes.
Rub the chops with the remaining oil, garlic, rosemary, salt and pepper.
Push the veg to the sides, add the chops to the tray and roast 18–20 minutes, turning once, until browned and cooked to your liking.
Rest the chops 5 minutes while you steam the beans and make the gravy with 1 cup boiling water.
Serve the chops with the roast veg, beans and gravy.
recipe.kids: Cut the meat off the bone for kids and serve the gravy on the side.

steps: Grill the kebabs 10–12 min.
Warm the pita and chop a salad.
Build plates with tzatziki.
Heat a BBQ, grill pan or large frying pan over medium-high heat (or the air fryer to 200°C).
Cook the kebabs 10–12 minutes, turning every few minutes, until golden and cooked through with no pink inside (air fryer: 12 minutes, turning halfway).
Toss the tomato and cucumber with the oregano and a pinch of salt.
Warm the pita in a dry pan or the microwave for 20 seconds.
Serve the kebabs with pita, salad and a big spoon of tzatziki, with lemon on the side.
recipe.kids: Slide the chicken off the sticks and let kids build their own wraps.

steps: Brown the kofta.
Simmer in pasta sauce 10 min.
Fill rolls, top with cheese and grill.

ingredients: 450 g lamb or beef kofta, cut into 4 cm pieces
steps: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and brown the kofta pieces for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and pasta sauce, cover and simmer 10 minutes until the kofta are cooked through.
Heat the oven grill. Split the rolls and toast the cut sides for 1 minute.
Fill each roll with spinach, kofta and sauce, then top with mozzarella.
Grill 2–3 minutes until the cheese melts. Serve with extra sauce for dipping.
recipe.kids: Skip the spinach and give kids extra cheese.

steps: Brown the chicken and onion.
Add rice, pumpkin and stock; bake 35 min.
Stir in parmesan and spinach.

ingredients: 500 g chicken breast, cut into 2 cm pieces
400 g pumpkin, cut into 1.5 cm cubes
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Heat the oil in a large ovenproof pot or casserole over medium-high heat.
Brown the chicken 4 minutes, then add the onion and cook 3 minutes until soft.
Stir in the rice for 1 minute, then add the pumpkin and hot stock. Bring to a simmer.
Cover with a lid and bake 30–35 minutes until the rice is tender and most of the stock is absorbed.
Stir in the butter, parmesan and spinach until creamy. Add a splash of water if it's too thick.
Rest 3 minutes and serve.
recipe.kids: Serve kids a plain scoop before the spinach goes in.
